---
title: "Assignments for 431 in Fall 2026"
date: last-modified
---

Assignments for 431 include two [projects](#projects), seven [labs](#labs), two [quizzes]($quizzes), and a series of [minute papers](#minute-papers).

In addition to the links below, our [Syllabus](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/) is your best source for additional information on all course [assignments](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/10_assignments.html), as well as on how the course is [graded](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/11_grading.html).

## Projects

The most important assignments this semester are the projects. 

- The [Project A page](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-projectA-2026/) provides instructions and materials related to Project A.
- The [Project B page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-projectB-2026) provides Project B instructions and materials.

Project deadlines are specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Labs

The [Lab page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-labs-2026) links to instructions and materials for each of the seven lab assignments. 

- Lab deadlines are specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Quizzes

The [Quiz page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-quiz-2026) links to instructions and materials for the two Quizzes. 

- Each Quiz is an open-book assessment of everything we'll do between the start of the course and Class 13 (for Quiz 1) and Class 24 (for Quiz 2.)
- Relevant dates for the Quiz are provided on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd).

## Minute Papers

The [Minute Paper page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-minute-2026) provides links to Minute Paper assignments and related feedback documents from Professor Love.

- Minute papers focus on assessments of how the course is going, providing reminders of key issues, and gathering student views.
- Minute Paper deadlines are specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Questions?

If you have any questions, [contact us](contact.qmd).
